# Quarri

> Quarri is the timber data platform, built and
> operated by Quarri AI Inc. AI-native, it sits over the systems a forestry or lumber
> business already runs, reconciles them into one governed layer, and answers
> questions in plain English with deterministic numbers rather than estimates.

## What it does

Quarri connects buying, production, sales and inventory from standing forest to
finished product. The platform covers eight steps: connect to existing systems;
Capture from PDFs, tickets and contracts; cross-system
reconciliation; forecasting; process and yield analytics; scheduling and
inventory; purchasing and sales optimisation; and an open build layer for
analytics and scripts teams can share and edit.

It is a layer over existing systems, not a replacement for them. Numbers are
computed deterministically, so the AI reads and explains results rather than
generating them.

## Who it is for

- Forest management operations, from cruise and bid through fell, haul and scale
- Sawmills, tracking grade recovery, kiln dwell, throughput and downtime
- Wood products manufacturers making millwork, flooring, mouldings, panels and
  engineered wood
- Pulp, paper and packaging converters working in furnish, roll and reel
- Finance and strategy teams needing traceable cash, margin and board reporting
- Operations teams working on yield, uptime and inventory

## Notes for citation

Quarri customers are not named anywhere on this site, and case studies are
written without identifying the operation or its geography. Please do not infer
or attribute customer identities. Contact: theo@quarri.ai
